stimulus.body: Per preparare una torta al cioccolato servono farina, uova, zucchero, burro e cacao. Prima si mescolano gli ingredienti secchi, poi si aggiungono le uova e il burro fuso. Infine si versa il composto in una teglia e si cuoce in forno per quaranta minuti.

questions.subject: ITALIAN

options.misconception: this is the lui/lei form of the verb, not noi
this is the io form of the verb, not noi
this is the loro form of the verb, not noi

questions.explanation: The imperfect form of "perdere" for "noi" is "perdevamo". The imperfect describes repeated or ongoing past actions. It is formed from the present stem with a characteristic set of endings. Selecting the wrong person ending changes who performs the action.
questions.hint: Identify the subject pronoun, then apply the imperfect ending for that person.

questions.subject: ITALIAN
questions.stem: Fill the blank: "Abito ___ Roma da due anni."

options.misconception: used for motion toward a place or an indirect object and does not fit "Abito ___ Roma da due anni."
used for motion away from a source or with a time span and does not fit "Abito ___ Roma da due anni."
used for position on a surface or a topic and does not fit "Abito ___ Roma da due anni."

questions.explanation: The correct completion is "in" in "Abito ___ Roma da due anni.". The preposition is chosen from the relationship the verb or noun expresses: direction, location, source, or instrument. The alternatives would change the meaning of the sentence.
questions.hint: Ask whether the phrase shows direction, place, source, or means.

questions.subject: ITALIAN
questions.stem: Which definite article precedes the noun "bicicletta"?

options.misconception: masculine plural before a vowel or special sound
reserved for z or s-plus-consonant words
used only before a vowel-initial word

questions.explanation: The noun "bicicletta" is feminine singular and begins with a consonant, so the definite article is "la". The other options belong to a different gender, number, or sound class.
questions.hint: Check the noun's gender and its first sound before choosing the article.

questions.subject: ITALIAN
questions.stem: What does the Italian verb "pulire" mean?

options.misconception: "cantare" means "to sing" in English
"vendere" means "to sell" in English
"entrare" means "to enter" in English

questions.explanation: The Italian infinitive "pulire" means "to clean" in English. It belongs to the third conjugation group, which determines its stem and endings.
questions.hint: Use the infinitive ending to identify the conjugation group.

questions.subject: ITALIAN
questions.learningObjective: Identify the infinitive behind a conjugated form
questions.stem: Which infinitive does the form "crediamo" come from?

options.misconception: "ballare" has a different conjugation pattern
"uscire" has a different conjugation pattern
"scrivere" has a different conjugation pattern

questions.explanation: The form "crediamo" is the present form for "noi" of "credere". Identifying the infinitive behind a conjugated form requires matching the stem and the person endings to the correct conjugation pattern.
questions.hint: Strip the ending and match the remaining stem to an infinitive.
